teaser.en: The 'male' kongwe: a dayflower judged male because its little flowers are smaller and duller than its partner's.
teaser.sw: Kongwe 'dume': mmea wa jenasi Commelina unaohesabiwa kuwa dume kwa sababu maua yake madogo ni madogo zaidi na yasiyong'aa kama ya mwenzake.
teaser.dg: *Kongwe* ya 'chilume': mmea wa *Commelina* (*dayflower*) ambao Adigo anauona ni wa chilume kpwa sababu maruwage madide ni madide zaidi, na rangiye tainang'ala dza ya maruwa ga myawe.

summary.en: Kongwe lume is a small creeping dayflower with pale bluish flowers. In Digo it is the 'male' of a pair, set against the larger, deep-blue-flowered kongwe chetu.
summary.sw: Kongwe lume ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa wa jenasi Commelina wenye maua ya buluu hafifu. Kwa Kidigo ni 'dume' wa jozi, akilinganishwa na kongwe chetu mwenye maua makubwa zaidi ya buluu iliyokolea.
summary.dg: *Kongwe lume* ni mmea mdide unaoambala wa *Commelina*, wenye maruwa ga samawati ngushu-ngushu. Kpwa Chidigo ni 'chilume' kahi ya mimea miiri, na myawe ni *kongwe chetu*, yenye maruwa makulu ga samawati nzito.

about.en: Kongwe lume is a low, creeping herb with jointed stems that root at the nodes. Its leaves are narrow and often have wavy edges. Each small flower comes out of a folded leafy bract. The flowers are pale blue to greyish and less glossy than those of related dayflowers, and they last only part of a day. Digo people identify it by the look of its leaves; Pakia lists it as a grass-like plant.
about.sw: Kongwe lume ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa chini, wenye mashina yenye vifundo yanayotoa mizizi kwenye vifundo hivyo. Majani yake ni membamba na mara nyingi yana kingo za mawimbi. Kila ua dogo hutoka ndani ya kibrakti cha jani kilichokunjwa. Maua ni ya buluu hafifu hadi kijivu, hayang'ai kama ya mimea mingine ya jenasi hii, na hudumu sehemu tu ya siku. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya majani yake; Pakia anauorodhesha kama mmea unaofanana na nyasi.
about.dg: *Kongwe lume* ni mmea mdide unaoambala photsi, wenye mihi ya mafundo inayolavya mizi phatu pha mafundo. Makodzage ni membamba, na mara nyinji gana maimbi kanda-kanda. Chila ruwa ridide rinatuluka ndani ya kodza ridide rinalokundzika. Maruwa ni ga samawati ngushu-ngushu hadi rangi ya ivu, tagang'ala dza ga *Commelina* zanjina, na ganakala kpwa seemu tu ya siku. Adigo anaumanya kpwa umbo ra makodzage; Pakia anauika kahi ya mimea inayohalana na nyasi.

where.en: It grows in open grassland, sandy places, farms and disturbed ground, spreading low among other herbs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika wazi za nyasi, sehemu za mchanga, mashambani na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa, ukitanda chini katikati ya mimea mingine midogo.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye mavuwe, phatu phenye mtsanga, mindani na phatu tsi iriphobanangwa, uchitandazika photsi kahi ya mimea midide yanjina.

culture.en: This is one of Pakia's clearest examples of the Digo male-and-female naming of plant pairs. *Kongwe chetu*, 'female kongwe' (*Commelina bracteosa*), has large, deep blue flowers. *Kongwe lume*, 'male kongwe', is so called because its flowers are smaller and less shiny, closer to grey. Usually, Pakia notes, sharp and dangerous features make a plant 'male'. Here a plainer, smaller flower does.
culture.sw: Huu ni mojawapo ya mifano iliyo wazi zaidi ya Pakia ya utaratibu wa Kidigo wa kuipa jozi za mimea majina ya dume na jike. *Kongwe chetu*, 'kongwe jike' (*Commelina bracteosa*), ana maua makubwa ya buluu iliyokolea. *Kongwe lume*, 'kongwe dume', anaitwa hivyo kwa sababu maua yake ni madogo zaidi na hayang'ai sana, yakikaribia kijivu. Kwa kawaida, Pakia anaeleza, sifa kali na hatari ndizo humfanya mmea kuwa 'dume'. Hapa ni ua jepesi na dogo zaidi.
culture.dg: Uhu ni mwenga wa mifwano ya wazi zaidi ya Pakia ya vira Adigo anavyoiha mimea miiri kpwa chilume na chichetu. *Kongwe chetu*, '*kongwe* ya chichetu' (*Commelina bracteosa*), ina maruwa makulu ga samawati nzito. *Kongwe lume*, '*kongwe* ya chilume', inaihwa vivyo kpwa sababu maruwage ni madide zaidi na tagang'ala sana, ga rangi iriyo phephi na ya ivu. Pakia anagomba kukala kpwa kawaida vitu vikali na vya hatari ndivyo vinavyohenda mmea ukale 'mlume'. Phapha, ruwa ridide zaidi, risiro na rangi ya kung'ala, ndiro rinalouhenda ukale vivyo.

names.en: Digo: *kongwe lume*, 'male kongwe'. Its partner *kongwe chetu* is shared with Swahili, according to Pakia. In Pakia's Appendix III, *Commelina bracteosa* is also called *chidzedza*. No English or Swahili name is recorded for this species.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kongwe lume*, 'kongwe dume'. Mwenzake *kongwe chetu* ni jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiswahili, kwa mujibu wa Pakia. Katika Kiambatisho III cha Pakia, *Commelina bracteosa* pia huitwa *chidzedza*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *kongwe lume*, '*kongwe* ya chilume'. Pakia anagomba kukala dzina ra myawe, *kongwe chetu*, ni ra Chidigo na ra Chiswahili. Kpwenye *Appendix III* ya Pakia, *Commelina bracteosa* piya inaihwa *chidzedza*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa kpwa aina ihi.

reason.en: Commelina bracteosa, its 'female' partner kongwe chetu
Another 'male' plant in a Digo male–female pair
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine 'dume' katika jozi ya dume na jike ya Kidigo
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa 'chilume' kahi ya mimea miiri ya Chidigo ya chilume na chichetu
